response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but the resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth-engineering work — the core domain focus of this Principal role. While he meets the general seniority and language-proficiency bar, there's no demonstrated track record in A/B testing, rollout risk management, or cross-team measurement systems, making him a poor match for this specialized position despite strong general engineering skills.
strengths: 15+ years of broad technical experience across many languages (JS/TS, C, C++, C#, Java, DLang) and system types
History of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source ownership (GISCollective)
Demonstrated adaptability across full-stack, embedded, and infrastructure work at various companies
concerns: No visible experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or A/B testing platforms
No evidence of telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or data-driven growth engineering work
Career shows lateral movement across many small/mid companies rather than deep platform-scale ownership matching Principal/IC6 scope

key_factors.factor: Broad multi-language engineering experience and seniority
